channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: If Crosby Can't Go, It Looks Like McDavid Will Get A Chance At Captaining Canada To Gold
item.description: IIHF rules require that every team must dress a captain at the Olympics. If so, then it's pretty clear that Canada will give Connor McDavid the 'C.'

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Predicting Each Semifinal Matchup
item.description: The 2026 Olympic men's hockey semifinal matchups are now set, with Canada taking on Finland and the U.S. squaring off against Slovakia. Here are our picks to advance to the gold medal game.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Bruins Reportedly Pursuing Justin Faulk, Latest Penguins Trade Deadline Buzz
item.description: The Boston Bruins' search for a right-shot defenseman has them focused on Justin Faulk of the St. Louis Blues. Meanwhile, there's speculation over the Pittsburgh Penguins' plans for the upcoming trade deadline.

item.title: Switzerland's MVP And Youngsters Shine Again, Winning Women's Hockey Bronze
item.description: Alina Muller put in an MVP-worthy performance for Switzerland at these Olympics, while youngsters drove the rise of the Swiss and Swedes. Here are key takeaways from both teams in the bronze medal game and the tournament.

item.title: Who's To Blame For Sweden's Early Exit In The Olympics?
item.description: With aspirations of winning gold, Team Sweden exits the 2026 Olympics empty-handed, leaving plenty of questions for everyone involved.

item.title: How Has The Quinn Hughes Trade Turned Out For The Canucks And Wild So Far?
item.description: It's been just over two months since the blockbuster trade that sent superstar defenseman Quinn Hughes from Vancouver to the Minnesota Wild. How has each player in the trade performed for their new team?

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Reacting To USA Beating Canada For Women's Hockey Gold
item.description: Join the live chat as we react to Team USA capturing women's hockey gold over Canada in overtime.

item.title: Team USA Goes From Near Defeat To Gold Medal Glory Vs. Canada In Women's Hockey
item.description: Team USA trailed Canada with less than three minutes in regulation. But they got the job done in captain Hilary Knight's final Olympic game, tying it up and scoring in overtime to capture the gold medal.

item.title: Maple Leafs' Auston Matthews Has The Opportunity To Silence Critics During Olympic Medal Round
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs superstar Auston Matthews is facing massive pressure to lead Team USA to a gold medal performance at the 2026 Olympics. Can Matthews come through in the clutch and silence his critics, or is heartbreak ahead for him?

item.title: Megan Keller Proves Team USA Had 'Unbelievable' Combination Of Clutch Veterans And Young Guns
item.description: Megan Keller juked around a Team Canada defender before putting a backhand past the goalie to secure a gold medal. Her teammates knew she could pull that off in that moment after Hilary Knight tied the game.
